title: Agents
subtitle: Create a new Agent to route specific channels to a separate personality or workspace.

gen.placeholder: Describe the persona you want (e.g. a calm, witty research assistant who loves detail)...
gen.singleSubtitle: The agent's other persona files are used as context. A small tweak or a full rewrite is up to your description.
gen.setSubtitle: Generates the core persona files together, using existing files as context. A small tweak or a full rewrite is up to your description.
gen.reviewSubtitle: Review and edit before saving. Nothing is written until you save.

emptyState.title: No agents yet
emptyState.description: Create your first agent to start routing channels, skills, and workspace settings.

createDialog.title: Add Agent
createDialog.description: Create a new agent by name. You can optionally inherit the main agent's workspace bootstrap files.
createDialog.inheritWorkspaceDescription: Copy SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, etc. from the main agent
createDialog.skillsDescription: Select skills enabled only for this agent.

deleteDialog.title: Permanently delete Agent?
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{{name}}" from $t(common:appName)? This permanently deletes the agent and its $t(common:appName)-managed workspace, runtime, and session files from disk.
deleteDialog.messageLast: Delete "{{name}}" from $t(common:appName)? This is the last agent, so the list will become empty. You can add a new first agent afterwards.

settingsDialog.title: {{name}} Settings
settingsDialog.description: Update the agent name and manage which channels belong to this agent.
settingsDialog.globalModelsDescription: Configure the default models used by all agents.
settingsDialog.modelProviderEmpty: No provider accounts configured. Add one in Settings → AI Providers.
settingsDialog.ttsProviderDesc: Choose which configured provider is used for text-to-speech across all agents.
settingsDialog.ttsProviderEmpty: No provider with speech synthesis configured. Add one in Settings → AI Providers.
settingsDialog.transcriptionProviderEmpty: No provider with speech transcription configured. Add one in Settings → AI Providers.
settingsDialog.modelOverrideDescription: Select provider and model ID for this agent.
settingsDialog.unsavedChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes. If you close now, your changes will be discarded.
settingsDialog.setAsDefaultHint: Conversations without a channel binding use this default agent.
settingsDialog.channelsDescription: This list is read-only. Use the “Bind Channels” button on the agent card to manage account bindings.
settingsDialog.skillsDescription: Only selected skills are enabled for this agent.
settingsDialog.channelsManagedInChannels: This agent is linked to channel types. Manage account-level bindings via the “Bind Channels” button on the agent card.
settingsDialog.noChannels: No channels are assigned to this agent yet.
settingsDialog.enableModelTypeDesc: When enabled, you can specify a model for this capability. When disabled, it falls back to the global default model.
settingsDialog.usingDefaultModel: Currently using the global default model. To specify a model for this agent, enable the switch above.
settingsDialog.modelDisabled: This model type is disabled globally.

channelBindingDialog.title: {{name}} · Bind Channels
channelBindingDialog.description: Select the channel accounts to bind to this agent. Each channel account can be handled by only one agent at a time.
channelBindingDialog.emptyDescription: Add and configure channel accounts on the Channels page first, then come back here to bind them.
channelBindingDialog.boundToOther: Currently handled by {{agent}} — enabling this reassigns it to this agent

removeChannelDialog.title: Remove Channel
removeChannelDialog.message: Remove {{name}} from $t(common:appName)? This deletes the current channel configuration.

skills.globalSectionHint: Toggles only affect this agent. Edit the all-agent list via All-agent Skill Configuration on the Skills page.
skills.otherSectionHint: Skills outside the all-agent allowlist, assigned only to this agent.

toast.agentModelInvalid: Model must be in provider/model format
